storeDescription: a wide single-storey electronics superstore with a flat roof, plain grey panelled walls, a tall tapered entry tower at the corner of the frontage, a curved canopy wrapping the entrance beneath it, and a broad asphalt parking lot in front of the entrance
_logoNote: LOGO: the four marks are written from the reference files in data/brands/logos/circuit-city/ (checked 11 Sep 2026): Wards TV, the italic wordmark, the red panel with the tagline, the disc emblem. logoSpec: the wordmark Wards TV: a large capital W whose right-hand stroke extends into one long horizontal bar running above the rest of the word
ards in lowercase rounded letterforms tucked beneath that bar, then TV in block capitals of the same weight
white individual channel letters mounted on the deep-red face of the entry tower, no sign box
